limitations: This is a pragmatic code review plus 37 synthetic controls, not a formal proof across every supported grammar or a production-readiness certification.

The lexical screen deliberately retains comments, literals, quoted strings, patterns, escapes, numeric-dot forms and some substring matches as safe false positives; this may still hit caps or increase overhead.

scope_complete covers the bounded retrieved supported pool, explicit unsupported frontier and exempt parse diagnostics; it is not global semantic repository completeness. Global project document-frequency scoring remains unchanged.
The new coarse phase can securely read up to100 source files/2MiB before the separate old24-file/2MiB AST phase and final current-version re-reads; do not describe this as an unchanged24-read cap.

Coarse2s checks occur between bounded synchronous operations; index refresh/Git/ignore verification, parser subprocess and delivery have distinct scopes. There is no newly established hard end-to-end latency or RSS ceiling.

Exact v3 evidence sufficiency/ambiguity remains a syntax heuristic, not behavioral correctness or relevant dependency completeness. Independent fresh evaluation is required before any coverage/performance claim.
